Qui est Sonar ? Sonar dirige l'avenir du développement de logiciels centrés sur les agents. En tant que leader de l'examen et de la vérification des codes d'IA, nous résolvons un problème critique : veiller à ce que les logiciels générés par les développeurs assistés par AI ou les agents autonomes soient fiables, sécurisés et durables. En s'intégrant parfaitement avec Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini et Devin, nous aidons plus de 75% des logiciels de construction Fortune 100 fiables, conformes. Les clients qui utilisent Sonar sont 44 % moins susceptibles de signaler une panne en raison du code généré par l'IA. Nous croyons que la vérification du code est le lien manquant essentiel dans le cycle de développement Agent-Centric (AC/DC). Des géants de l'industrie comme Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca et Ford Motor Company. compte sur nous pour fournir un examen indépendant, explicable, cohérent et la gouvernance de leur code généré par l'IA via des produits comme:
• SonarQube: Le monde est la principale plate-forme de révision et de vérification de code AI.
• SonarQube Foundation Agent: En ce moment, les classements pour la réparation de logiciels mandataires.
• SonarSweep & Sonar Contexte Augmentation : fournir le contexte de qualité entreprise et les agents de contraintes doivent être vraiment efficaces. Notre équipe opère à travers des centres mondiaux à Austin, Bochum, Dubaï, Genève, Londres, Singapour, Tokyo et Washington D.C. Nous bougeons avec un état d'esprit que nous appelons CODE:
• Engagement envers nos clients et notre communauté.
• Obsédé par la qualité.
• Délibérer dans nos décisions.
• Efficace comme une seule équipe. Avec plus de 400 M$ de revenus et une croissance rentable et rapide, nous construisons l'épine dorsale de la révolution logicielle de l'IA. Si vous avez faim d'avoir un impact, voulez construire à un rythme rapide, et prêt à travailler à l'avant-garde de l'IA, nous voulons entendre de vous. Description de la position Chez Sonar, nous croyons que la simple déclaration des problèmes de code n'est pas suffisante. Pour vraiment améliorer la qualité des logiciels du monde, nous devons permettre à des millions de développeurs de les réparer automatiquement. Avec plus de 400 000 entreprises qui comptent sur nos produits, nous tenons un levier unique pour façonner la façon dont le logiciel est construit. Les percées récentes dans l'IA ont fait de l'assainissement autonome une réalité, mais un obstacle majeur demeure : la confiance. L'IA fait des erreurs et les entreprises ne peuvent pas automatiser ce qu'elles ne font pas confiance. C'est là que vous entrez. En tant qu'ingénieur principal / personnel, vous allez l'architecte de backend pour la réparation autonome vérifiée , un flux de travail Agentique sophistiqué qui ne génère pas seulement du code, mais teste et valide rigoureusement à l'aide du moteur d'analyse Sonar. Vous vous attaquerez aux problèmes d'ingénierie difficiles nécessaires pour combler le « fossé de confiance ». Ce que vous ferez
• Architecte le « Moteur unifié d'assainissement ». Vous concevrez la logique de décision à haut débit qui guide nos efforts d'assainissement. Vous allez construire les services de backend qui orientent intelligemment les demandes entre des QuickFixes instantanés déterministes, des correctifs de raisonnement basés sur LLM et des flux Agentiques complexes.
• Construire une architecture d'agent robuste. Vous contribuerez au code d'agent d'assainissement Sonar, transformant les concepts de recherche en un service de production résistant et à grande échelle. Vous mettrez en œuvre des workflows autoguérisants où l'Agent corrige itérativement le code qu'il produit jusqu'à ce que la construction soit verte.
• Résoudre le problème de "Sandboxing". Vous concevrez les environnements d'exécution sécurisés nécessaires pour exécuter le code généré par l'IA. Vous concevrez les couches d'isolation qui permettent aux Agents d'itérer sur les améliorations de code sans compromettre notre infrastructure.
• Ingénieur pour la fiabilité et la sécurité. Vous mettrez en place des mécanismes de sécurité critiques, comme les disjoncteurs pour réacheminer automatiquement les demandes vers le moteur approprié lorsque les taux d'acceptation baissent. Surtout, vous aurez le compromis coût/performance, assurant notre architecture AWS échelle à des millions d'événements sans laisser spirale des coûts symboliques.
• Agissez comme un « multiplicateur de force » technique. Au-delà des systèmes de construction, vous mentorez l'équipe à travers des examens de conception et collaborez avec l'équipe de recherche pour s'assurer que notre agent n'est pas seulement à la fine pointe de la technologie, mais en sécurité de production. Expérience et qualifications
• Forte expertise backend & Cloud. Vous avez 8 ans et plus d'expérience dans la construction de systèmes résilients évolutives. Vous êtes fort dans l'architecture AWS et savez concevoir pour une grande disponibilité et faible latence avec des coûts en tête.
• Écosystèmes polyglottes (Java et Python). Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement hybride : Java pour une intégration profonde avec le moteur d'analyse Core Sonar et Python pour la couche de raisonnement AI/Agent. Tu devrais être forte dans l'un et capable dans l'autre. Nous utilisons divers outils LLM, et nous cherchons des gens qui n'ont pas peur des différentes langues.
• Les systèmes réfléchissent. Vous comprenez que "AI" dans la production est principalement "Ingénierie de systèmes." Vous savez comment gérer les architectures asynchrones, gérer les files d'attente et concevoir des environnements d'exécution sandboxed pour exécuter un code non fiable en toute sécurité.
• Intégration AI & LLM. Vous avez une expérience pratique de construction d'applications qui orchestrent les LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, ou les modèles ouverts hébergés). Vous comprenez la complexité du moteur de RAG, la gestion des fenêtres contextuelles et l'ingénierie rapide à l'échelle.
• C'est un jeu de mots. Tu tiens au "Pourquoi". Vous voulez construire des pipelines de télémétrie qui distinguent entre "Bad UX" et "Bad Code", en se concentrant sur les mesures qui comptent. Commentaires supplémentaires Ce rôle est basé à Genève. Nous ne sommes pas en mesure de considérer les candidats qui ne veulent pas être à Genève, mais nous sommes prêts à déplacer le bon candidat. Nous apprécions la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion Chez Sonar, nous croyons que notre diversité est notre force. Nous sommes une entreprise mondiale qui valorise et respecte différents horizons, perspectives et cultures. Nous sommes déterminés à favoriser un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif où chacun se sent valorisé et habilité à contribuer le mieux possible. Nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur sur un pied d'égalité et d'accueillir tous les candidats qualifiés, peu importe la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l'identité ou l'expression de genre, l'orientation sexuelle, l'origine nationale, la génétique, le handicap, l'âge ou le statut de vétéran. Si vous avez besoin d'un logement, veuillez communiquer avec nous à l'adresse embauche@sonarsource.com . Toutes les offres d'emploi chez Sonar dépendent des résultats d'une vérification complète des antécédents et des références effectuée avant la date de début. Nous ne soutenons pas actuellement les candidats au visa aux États-Unis. Les demandes présentées par des organismes ou des tiers recruteurs ne seront pas prises en considération.

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do Daily:

• Conduct inbound and outbound prospecting activities, including cold calls, email outreach, and LinkedIn engagement.

• Research and identify potential leads and target accounts based on defined criteria.

• Leverage various tools and resources like Salesforce, Salesloft, and Zoominfo to build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospects.

• Qualify leads by assessing their fit with our ideal customer profile and understanding their needs.

• Document and update lead information and interactions in our CRM.

• Collaborate with marketing to align lead-generation efforts with campaigns and initiatives.

• Collaborate with the sales team to transition qualified leads for further engagement.

The Experience You Will Need:

• Proven successful experience in outbound lead generation; ideally in a SaaS or subscription model.

• Strong time management and attention to detail.

• Highly organized and strategic in workflow.

• Strong English-language communication and listening skills: ability to handle objections as well as to take feedback and coaching.

• A proactive attitude and goal-oriented mindset with a focus on meeting or exceeding targets.

• Strong collaboration and teamwork skills to work closely with the sales teams.

• Desirable language skills: Spanish, French, German, Arabic

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

• Obsessed con qualità.
• Deliberate nelle nostre decisioni.
• Efficace come una squadra. Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari di ricavi e crescita redditizia e rapida, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione software AI. Se hai fame di avere un impatto, vuoi costruire ad un ritmo veloce, e pronto a lavorare in prima linea di AI, vogliamo sentire da te. Cosa farai ogni giorno:
• Condurre attività di prospezione in entrata e in uscita, tra cui chiamate fredde, e-mail di outreach, e il coinvolgimento LinkedIn.
• La ricerca e l'identificazione di potenziali cavi e account target basati su criteri definiti.
• Sfrutta vari strumenti e risorse come Salesforce, Salesloft e Zoominfo per costruire e mantenere una sana pipeline di prospettive.
• Qualificare conduce valutando la loro forma con il nostro profilo cliente ideale e la comprensione delle loro esigenze.
• Documento e aggiornamento delle informazioni di piombo e delle interazioni nel nostro CRM.
• Collabora con il marketing per allineare gli sforzi di lead-generation con campagne e iniziative.
• Collaborare con il team di vendita alla transizione di cavi qualificati per un ulteriore impegno. L'esperienza di cui avrete bisogno:
• Provata esperienza di successo nella generazione di piombo in uscita; idealmente in un SaaS o modello di abbonamento.
• Forte gestione del tempo e attenzione ai dettagli.
• Flusso di lavoro altamente organizzato e strategico.
• Forte comunicazione in lingua inglese e capacità di ascolto: capacità di gestire le obiezioni e di prendere feedback e coaching.
• Un atteggiamento proattivo e una mentalità orientata verso l'obiettivo, con l'obiettivo di soddisfare o superare gli obiettivi.
• Forte collaborazione e competenze di lavoro di squadra per lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di vendita.
• Desiderabili competenze linguistiche: spagnolo, francese, tedesco, arabo Cultura in ufficio Siamo intenzionali. Crediamo che le migliori squadre siano costruite nella stanza insieme. Tre giorni di ancora — lunedì, martedì e giovedì — creano il ritmo di collaborazione che rende un hub office degno di avere. I candidati devono essere autenticamente basati nel luogo in cui il ruolo è pubblicato — se non è lì che sei oggi, siamo lieti di sostenere la delocalizzazione per la persona giusta. Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture. Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono valorizzati e potenziati per contribuire al meglio. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e di accogliere tutti i candidati qualificati, indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere o espressione, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, genetica, disabilità, età, o stato veterano. Se avete bisogno di un alloggio, contattateci all'indirizzo hiring@sonarsource.com . Tutte le offerte di lavoro a Sonar sono contingenti sui risultati di un controllo completo di sfondo e verifica di riferimento effettuato prima della data di inizio. Le domande che vengono presentate tramite agenzie o reclutatori di terze parti non saranno considerate.

Durch die nahtlose Integration mit Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini und Devin helfen wir über 75% der Fortune 100 dabei, vertrauenswürdige, zuverlässige und konforme Software zu erstellen. Unser Team ist in globalen Hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Genf, London, Singapur, Tokio und Washington D.C. tätig. Wir bewegen uns mit einer Denkweise, die wir CODE nennen:

• Besessen von Qualität.

• Nachgewiesene erfolgreiche Erfahrung in der Outbound Lead Generation; idealerweise in einem SaaS- oder Abonnementmodell.
• Starkes Zeitmanagement und Liebe zum Detail.
• Hoch organisiert und strategisch im Workflow.
• Starke englischsprachige Kommunikation und Hörfähigkeit: Fähigkeit, Einwände zu behandeln sowie Feedback und Coaching zu nehmen.
• Eine proaktive Haltung und zielorientierte Denkweise mit dem Fokus auf das Erreichen oder Übertreffen von Zielen.
• Starke Zusammenarbeit und Teamfähigkeit, um eng mit den Verkaufsteams zusammenzuarbeiten.

Wenn Sie eine Unterkunft benötigen, kontaktieren Sie uns bitte unter hiring@sonarsource.com. jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
 SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
 SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
 SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
 Committed to our customers and community.

•
 Obsessed with quality.

•
 Deliberate in our decisions.

•
 Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

Sonar is looking for a passionate product design generalist to join our Product Design team, which owns the experience for our robust platform of code quality and security products. You will belong to one of our product areas, where you’ll help ensure that our developer and agent users write better code and have a seamless experience in the product.

You will work closely with Product Management and Engineering to ensure that the proposed solutions meet the expected outcome and that we collectively deliver the best products to help development teams write better and more secure code. You will also collaborate with other designers and researchers across the organization, ensuring consistency and contributing to best practices.

What you will do

•
 Own product design for a squad and advocate for a world-class user experience.

•
 Research and map complex user workflows to ensure our solutions are intuitive and highly functional.

•
 Integrate AI into every stage of your design workflow, leveraging it to accelerate research synthesis, automate repetitive tasks, and explore high-fidelity prototypes more efficiently.

•
 Listen to our users and customers to understand their needs. Develop a deep understanding of the SDLC and how we can enable developers and AI agents to produce better quality software.

•
 Work closely with other product designers to ensure a cohesive information architecture and a unified experience across the entire product platform.

•
 Align with your product manager on problem definition, providing design solutions throughout the end-to-end development stage.

•
 Partner with engineering teams early in the design process to vet technical feasibility and uncover edge cases.

•
 Help the Product Design team grow by contributing to our design processes, tools, and collaborative frameworks.

Experience and qualifications

•
 Experience organizing data-heavy environments into logical structures and mapping user journeys that minimize friction.

•
 Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience using AI tools to accelerate research, ideation and design velocity.

•
 A self-starter mindset with the drive to identify UX gaps and propose structural improvements without being prompted.

•
 Ability to articulate design decisions and the "why" behind them to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

•
 Comfort working in a cross-functional environment where feedback is shared openly and success is a team effort.

•
 Delivery mindset. Your role does not end when the design is handed off.

•
 Bonus points if you have a technical background in computer science or software development.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

We do not currently support visa candidates in the US.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Appartenerai a una delle nostre aree di prodotto, dove aiuterai a garantire che i nostri utenti di sviluppatori e agenti scrivano un codice migliore e abbiano un'esperienza senza soluzione di continuità nel prodotto. • Ascolta i nostri utenti e clienti per capire le loro esigenze. Sviluppare una profonda comprensione del SDLC e come possiamo consentire agli sviluppatori e agenti AI di produrre software di qualità migliore.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con altri designer di prodotti per garantire un'architettura di informazioni coesa e un'esperienza unificata in tutta la piattaforma di prodotto.
• Allineare con il vostro product manager sulla definizione dei problemi, fornendo soluzioni di progettazione durante la fase di sviluppo end-to-end.
• Partner con i team di ingegneria all'inizio del processo di progettazione per verificare la fattibilità tecnica e scoprire i casi di bordo.
• Aiuta il team di Product Design a crescere contribuendo ai nostri processi di progettazione, strumenti e strutture collaborative. Esperienza e qualifiche
• Sperimenta l'organizzazione di ambienti data-heavy in strutture logiche e mappando i viaggi degli utenti che minimizzano l'attrito.
• Curiosità dimostrata e esperienza pratica utilizzando strumenti AI per accelerare la ricerca, l'ideazione e la velocità di progettazione.
• Una mentalità auto-starter con l'azionamento per identificare le lacune UX e proporre miglioramenti strutturali senza essere richiesto.
• Capacità di articolare le decisioni di progettazione e il "perché" dietro di loro sia agli stakeholder tecnici che non tecnici.
• Comfort lavorando in un ambiente interfunzionale in cui il feedback è condiviso apertamente e il successo è uno sforzo di squadra.
• Mente di consegna. Il tuo ruolo non finisce quando il design viene consegnato.
• Punti bonus se si dispone di uno sfondo tecnico in informatica o sviluppo software. Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture. Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono valorizzati e potenziati per contribuire al meglio. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e di accogliere tutti i candidati qualificati, indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere o espressione, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, genetica, disabilità, età, o stato veterano. Se avete bisogno di un alloggio, contattateci all'indirizzo hiring@sonarsource.com . Tutte le offerte di lavoro a Sonar sono contingenti sui risultati di un controllo completo di sfondo e verifica di riferimento effettuato prima della data di inizio. Attualmente non sosteniamo i candidati del visto negli Stati Uniti. Le domande che vengono presentate tramite agenzie o reclutatori di terze parti non saranno considerate.

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

Sonar is looking for a customer-centric Platform Product Manager to drive the foundational capabilities that make our products enterprise-ready, trusted by the world’s largest organizations and truly loved by developers around the world. You will be part of the Product Management team that drives the vision and roadmaps for our core platform infrastructure. We are currently looking for Product Managers with a deep technical background in enterprise SaaS capabilities.

This role sits at the intersection of core infrastructure and customer needs. As a Product Manager, you will shape our platform, ensuring that our customers experience enterprise-grade reliability, compliance, and top-tier performance, and have a seamless experience in the product. To achieve this perfect match, we need a passionate Product Manager who will research, clarify, prioritize the needs of external IT administrators, DevOps, and security teams, and translate those needs across our product line. You will become an expert user of our core platform, from very high-level user settings down to the technical aspects of our infrastructure.

You will join the Product Management team, which is composed of other passionate Product Managers eager to collaborate with you. You will also work closely with engaged Engineering teams to ensure that the proposed solutions meet the expected outcome and that we collectively deliver the best products to help teams adopt our software at scale to write better and more secure code.

By joining us, you will bring your deep knowledge of enterprise-grade platforms (such as data sovereignty, encryption, or global performance scaling) and your experience as a Product Manager to help us reach the next level and provide an awesome user experience to millions of developers.

What you will do

• Contribute to the different areas of the Platform vision and communicate about them, internally and externally.

•
 Research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities to build and maintain an effective roadmap, focused on customer trust and platform readiness.

•
 Interact directly with our users and customers on our product forum to support them, integrate their feedback, and identify opportunities.

•
 Develop a deep understanding of customer-facing platform needs (e.g., data residency, advanced access controls, and application performance) and how we can enable organizations to scale seamlessly..

•
 Work closely with other product managers to design cross-product foundational features.

•
 Align with the engineering and UX teams on the foundational system and usability problems to solve and support them during the end-to-end development stage of the solutions.

•
 Sync with the engineering teams to ensure that there is a good balance between innovation, consolidation, and stability.

•
 Attend conferences and give talks about platform scale if you like.

•
 Help the Product Management team grow in its organization, tools, and processes.

Experience and qualifications

• Passionate about enterprise software operability and the practices that lead to secure and highly available applications.

•
 Deep understanding of core platform pillars (e.g., data isolation, customer-managed encryption, design systems, API best-practices, or global performance optimization).

•
 Technical comprehension of self-hosted deployment, cloud-native environments, multi-region deployments, and data residency frameworks.

•
 Experience with the latest developments in AI assisted coding and how they impact platform scale.

•
 Experience in software product management, preferably managing platform products in an agile context.

•
 Highly autonomous and pragmatic, with an obsession for solving external customer problems.

•
 Open-minded and very positive can-do attitude.

•
 Comfortable in dealing with change, complexity, and uncertainty.

•
 Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo as well as to receive feedback.

•
 Leadership: you take initiative and demonstrate your ability to lead a subject from beginning to end.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Come leader nella verifica e nella governance del codice AI, risolviamo un problema critico: garantire che il software generato da sviluppatori assistiti da AI o agenti autonomi sia affidabile, sicuro e manutenbile. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità con Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini e Devin, aiutiamo oltre il 75% del software Fortune 100 costruire affidabile, affidabile, conforme. I clienti che utilizzano Sonar sono il 44% meno probabilità di segnalare un outage a causa del codice generato dall'IA. Crediamo che la verifica del codice sia il collegamento mancante fondamentale nel Ciclo di Sviluppo Agent-Centric (AC/DC). I giganti del settore come Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca e Ford Motor Company contano su di noi per fornire una revisione indipendente, spiegabile, coerente e la governance del loro codice generato dall'IA attraverso prodotti come:
• SonarQube: la piattaforma leader mondiale per la revisione e la verifica del codice AI.
• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Attualmente il lancio delle classifiche per la riparazione di software agentic.
• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Fornire il contesto di livello enterprise e gli agenti vincoli devono essere veramente efficaci. Il nostro team opera in tutto il mondo a Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Ginevra, Londra, Singapore, Tokyo e Washington D.C. Ci muoviamo con una mentalità che chiamiamo CODE:
• Impegnati ai nostri clienti e comunità.
• Obsessed con qualità.
• Deliberate nelle nostre decisioni.
• Efficace come una squadra. Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari di ricavi e crescita redditizia e rapida, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione software AI. Se hai fame di avere un impatto, vuoi costruire ad un ritmo veloce, e pronto a lavorare in prima linea di AI, vogliamo sentire da te. Descrizione della posizione Sonar è alla ricerca di un responsabile del prodotto della piattaforma incentrato sul cliente per guidare le capacità fondamentali che rendono i nostri prodotti pronti all'impresa, fidati dalle più grandi organizzazioni del mondo e veramente amato dagli sviluppatori di tutto il mondo. Sarete parte del team Product Management che guida la visione e le roadmap per la nostra infrastruttura di piattaforma core. Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di Product Manager con un profondo background tecnico nelle capacità SaaS aziendali. Questo ruolo si trova all'incrocio delle infrastrutture principali e delle esigenze dei clienti. In qualità di Product Manager, formerai la nostra piattaforma, garantendo ai nostri clienti un'esperienza di affidabilità, conformità e prestazioni di livello superiore e un'esperienza senza soluzione di continuità nel prodotto. Per ottenere questa corrispondenza perfetta, abbiamo bisogno di un Product Manager appassionato che cercherà, chiarirà, priorità le esigenze degli amministratori IT esterni, DevOps e team di sicurezza, e tradurre queste esigenze attraverso la nostra linea di prodotti. Potrai diventare un utente esperto della nostra piattaforma di base, dalle impostazioni utente di alto livello fino agli aspetti tecnici della nostra infrastruttura. Ti unirai al team Product Management, composto da altri appassionati Product Manager desiderosi di collaborare con te. Potrai anche lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di Engineering impegnati per garantire che le soluzioni proposte soddisfano il risultato previsto e che offriamo collettivamente i migliori prodotti per aiutare i team ad adottare il nostro software in scala per scrivere codice migliore e più sicuro. Unendoci, porterai la tua profonda conoscenza delle piattaforme di livello enterprise (come la sovranità dei dati, la crittografia o la scalabilità delle prestazioni globali) e la tua esperienza come Product Manager per aiutarci a raggiungere il livello successivo e fornire un'esperienza utente impressionante a milioni di sviluppatori. Cosa farai
• Contribuire alle diverse aree della visione della Piattaforma e comunicare su di loro, internamente ed esternamente.
• Ricerca, chiarimento e priorità opportunità di costruire e mantenere una roadmap efficace, focalizzata sulla fiducia del cliente e sulla prontezza della piattaforma.
• Interagisci direttamente con i nostri utenti e clienti sul nostro forum di prodotti per supportarli, integrare il loro feedback e identificare le opportunità.
• Sviluppare una profonda comprensione delle esigenze della piattaforma di customer-facing (ad esempio, la residenza dei dati, i controlli avanzati di accesso e le prestazioni delle applicazioni) e come possiamo consentire alle organizzazioni di scalare senza soluzione di continuità..
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con altri responsabili del prodotto per progettare caratteristiche di base cross-product.
• Allineare con i team di ingegneria e UX sul sistema di fondazione e problemi di usabilità per risolvere e supportarli durante la fase di sviluppo end-to-end delle soluzioni.
• Sincronizza con i team di ingegneria per garantire un buon equilibrio tra innovazione, consolidamento e stabilità.
• Partecipare a conferenze e dare colloqui su scala della piattaforma se ti piace.
• Aiuta il team di Product Management a crescere nella sua organizzazione, strumenti e processi. Esperienza e qualifiche
• Passione per l'operabilità del software aziendale e le pratiche che portano a applicazioni sicure e altamente disponibili.
• Profonda comprensione dei pilastri della piattaforma core (ad esempio, isolamento dei dati, crittografia gestita dal cliente, sistemi di progettazione, best practice API o ottimizzazione globale delle prestazioni).
• Comprensione tecnica di distribuzione self-hosted, ambienti cloud-native, distribuzioni multi-regioni e framework di residenza dei dati.
• Scopri gli ultimi sviluppi nella codifica assistita AI e come influiscono sulla scala della piattaforma.
• Esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti software, preferibilmente la gestione dei prodotti della piattaforma in un contesto agile.
• Altamente autonomo e pragmatico, con un'ossessione per risolvere i problemi dei clienti esterni.
• Atteggiamento can-do aperto e molto positivo.
• Confortevole nel trattare il cambiamento, la complessità e l'incertezza.
• abbastanza sicuro da sfidare lo status quo e ricevere feedback.
• Leadership: prendi l'iniziativa e dimostra la tua capacità di guidare un soggetto dall'inizio alla fine. Cultura in ufficio Siamo intenzionali. Crediamo che le migliori squadre siano costruite nella stanza insieme. Tre giorni di ancora — lunedì, martedì e giovedì — creano il ritmo di collaborazione che rende un hub office degno di avere. I candidati devono essere autenticamente basati nel luogo in cui il ruolo è pubblicato — se non è lì che sei oggi, siamo lieti di sostenere la delocalizzazione per la persona giusta. Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture. Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono valorizzati e potenziati per contribuire al meglio. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e di accogliere tutti i candidati qualificati, indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere o espressione, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, genetica, disabilità, età, o stato veterano. Se avete bisogno di un alloggio, contattateci all'indirizzo hiring@sonarsource.com . Tutte le offerte di lavoro a Sonar sono contingenti sui risultati di un controllo completo di sfondo e verifica di riferimento effettuato prima della data di inizio. Le domande che vengono presentate tramite agenzie o reclutatori di terze parti non saranno considerate.

En s'intégrant parfaitement avec Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini et Devin, nous aidons plus de 75% des logiciels de construction Fortune 100 fiables, conformes. Nous croyons que la vérification du code est le lien manquant essentiel dans le cycle de développement Agent-Centric (AC/DC). Les géants de l'industrie comme Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca et Ford Motor Company comptent sur nous pour fournir un examen indépendant, explicable, cohérent et la gouvernance de leur code généré par l'IA via des produits comme:
• SonarQube: Le monde est la principale plate-forme de révision et de vérification de code AI.

• Engagement envers nos clients et notre communauté.
• Obsédé par la qualité.
• Délibérer dans nos décisions.

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

The Impact You Will Have:

The Partner Manager wins, maintains, and expands relationships with assigned channel partners. Assigned to channel partners based on geography, channel, or market, the Partner Manager is responsible for achieving qualified pipeline development, profitability, and partner recruitment objectives. The Partner Manager represents the entire range of Sonar’s products and services to assigned partners though may focus on a specific solution or product set if focused in a partner vertical market. The Partner Manager reports to the Vice President of EMEA & APJ Channels. The success of a Sonar Partner is the success of a Partner Manager at Sonar! We believe the following will support a robust Partner Ecosystem and contribute to the success of Sonar’s strategic partners: We are looking for passionate and energetic team members to join us in building a strong and healthy partner ecosystem.

What You Will Do Daily:

• Discover, evaluate, and develop potential partners with business models and technology stacks that complement Sonar’s offerings

• Potential partners include Global and Regional Consulting Partners, System Integrators, Software Resellers, Technology Alliance and Distributors and where applicable Hyperscalers.

• Develop partner territory plan for a regional and execute the business plan to deliver outcomes measures in new bookings $, Renewal $ and % and new logos

• Establishes productive, professional, and strong relationships with key personnel in assigned partner accounts and territoriesInitiates the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, sales, marketing, and management resources that would contribute to the success of the partner ecosystem

• Engaged in meaningful business and account QBR’s to support partners in meeting assigned targets for profitable sales volume and strategic objectives in assigned partner accounts

• Build momentum and executable next steps in the joint partner planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones associated with a productive partner relationship

• Proactively assesses, clarifies, and validates partner needs on an ongoing basis

• Proactive management with Sonar’s channel policies, stringent expectations management of partners to minimize channel conflict

• Ensures partners receive and complete the required enablement program Ensures partner and Sonar’s continuous business and technology aligns and complies.

The Experience You Will Need:

• 7+ years of proven experience in channel and partner management in a technology software B2B, ideally in a SaaS or subscription model, Dev Tools experience would be a plus

• Proven track record in building, maintaining, and expanding high-performance partners in the EMEA region

• Self-starter, can-do attitude and willingness to roll up sleeves and never afraid to do the impossible

• Strong communication and listening skills, able to influence at all levels

• Strong ability to work effectively as part of a team. Be a bar raiser in the company values and culture

• Curious, willing to unlearn to learn. Confident and a great communicator

• MUST HAVE - Relationships and experience working with key VAR's including Softcat, Bytes, Computercentre, and Insight

• NICE TO HAVE - Working with Crayon SoftwareOne, bespoke DevOps VAR's

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

The Impact You Will Have:

The Partner Manager wins, maintains, and expands relationships with assigned channel partners. Assigned to channel partners based on geography, channel, or market, the Partner Manager is responsible for achieving qualified pipeline development, profitability, and partner recruitment objectives. The Partner Manager represents the entire range of Sonar’s products and services to assigned partners though may focus on a specific solution or product set if focused in a partner vertical market. The Partner Manager reports to the Vice President of EMEA & APJ Channels. The success of a Sonar Partner is the success of a Partner Manager at Sonar! We believe the following will support a robust Partner Ecosystem and contribute to the success of Sonar’s strategic partners: We are looking for passionate and energetic team members to join us in building a strong and healthy partner ecosystem.

What You Will Do Daily:

• Discover, evaluate, and develop potential partners with business models and technology stacks that complement Sonar’s offerings

• Potential partners include Global and Regional Consulting Partners, System Integrators, Software Resellers, Technology Alliance and Distributors and where applicable Hyperscalers.

• Develop partner territory plan for a regional and execute the business plan to deliver outcomes measures in new bookings $, Renewal $ and % and new logos

• Establishes productive, professional, and strong relationships with key personnel in assigned partner accounts and territoriesInitiates the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, sales, marketing, and management resources that would contribute to the success of the partner ecosystem

• Engaged in meaningful business and account QBR’s to support partners in meeting assigned targets for profitable sales volume and strategic objectives in assigned partner accounts

• Build momentum and executable next steps in the joint partner planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones associated with a productive partner relationship

• Proactively assesses, clarifies, and validates partner needs on an ongoing basis

• Proactive management with Sonar’s channel policies, stringent expectations management of partners to minimize channel conflict

• Ensures partners receive and complete the required enablement program Ensures partner and Sonar’s continuous business and technology aligns and complies.

The Experience You Will Need:

• 7+ years of proven experience in channel and partner management in a technology software B2B, ideally in a SaaS or subscription model, Dev Tools experience would be a plus

• Proven track record in building, maintaining, and expanding high-performance partners in the EMEA region

• Self-starter, can-do attitude and willingness to roll up sleeves and never afraid to do the impossible

• Strong communication and listening skills, able to influence at all levels

• Strong ability to work effectively as part of a team. Be a bar raiser in the company values and culture

• Curious, willing to unlearn to learn. Confident and a great communicator

• Desirable language skills: Polish

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists fully engaged in delivering systems that help our Finance, HR, and Operations teams do their best work. This role sits at the heart of our payroll and financial infrastructure — owning the administration of our global payroll platform (ADP) and ERP (NetSuite), while supporting the data accuracy that underpins our financial planning processes.

You will be the go-to expert ensuring payroll operations run accurately and compliantly across our global entities. You will maintain NetSuite as our reliable financial system of record, and collaborate with the Finance team on the data flows that feed planning and reporting. As Sonar continues to scale, your work will directly improve

What you will do
 You are comfortable owning the administration of our core payroll and financial platforms — ADP and NetSuite — for a fast-growing, multi-national organization. You ensure payroll processes are accurate and compliant, keep the ERP running smoothly, and support the data flows our Finance team depends on for planning and reporting.

Payroll Systems Administration (ADP)

• Own the end-to-end administration and configuration of ADP (Workforce Now preferred), ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant payroll processing across multiple entities.

• Manage user access, roles, and governance in ADP; coordinate with HR and Finance on payroll cycles, headcount changes, and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Maintain and improve data integrations between ADP and NetSuite — ensuring payroll journal entries, employee records, and cost allocations flow accurately and on schedule.

• Troubleshoot payroll discrepancies, manage the relationship with ADP support, and coordinate system updates and releases.

NetSuite ERP Administration

• Administer and maintain the NetSuite instance: user management, roles and permissions, workflows, saved searches, and module configurations (P2P, Multi-book, Intercompany, and others).

• Support month-end close activities and ensure NetSuite remains the trusted system of record for financial actuals.

• Lead change management processes — documenting, testing, and deploying system changes with proper controls and impact assessments.

• Support IT General Controls (ITGC) and SOX compliance requirements across financial systems.

Financial Planning & Reporting Support

• Collaborate with the Finance team to ensure actuals from NetSuite feed into our FP&A tools (e.g., Pigment or equivalent) accurately and on time.

• Develop a working understanding of FP&A processes — budgeting, rolling forecasts, and variance analysis — to support data validation and ad hoc reporting needs.

• Contribute to integration and data quality work between NetSuite and financial planning platforms as needs arise.

Experience and qualifications
 Experience & Technical Acumen

•
 Payroll Administration (Mandatory): 5+ years of hands-on experience administering ADP (Workforce Now preferred), including configuration, payroll processing workflows, compliance, and system integrations.

•
 NetSuite Administration (Mandatory): 5+ years of NetSuite administration in a multi-entity or multi-national environment; NetSuite Administrator certification is a plus.

•
 Familiarity with FP&A processes (budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis) and exposure to at least one FP&A or EPM tool (Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive Planning, or similar); deep hands-on expertise is not required.

•
 Practical experience with data integrations between payroll, HR, and financial systems via API or native connectors.

•
 Experience supporting internal controls (ITGC) and SOX compliance across financial systems.

•
 Bonus: experience with Carta, FloQast, BambooHR, or Aptitude.

• Efficace comme une seule équipe. Avec plus de 400 M$ de revenus et une croissance rentable et rapide, nous construisons l'épine dorsale de la révolution logicielle de l'IA. Si vous avez faim d'avoir un impact, voulez construire à un rythme rapide, et prêt à travailler à l'avant-garde de l'IA, nous voulons entendre de vous. Description de la position L'équipe de la technologie d'affaires est composée de technologues passionnés pleinement engagés dans la prestation de systèmes qui aident nos équipes des finances, des RH et des opérations à faire leur meilleur travail. Ce rôle est au cœur de notre infrastructure de paye et financière, qui possède l'administration de notre plateforme de paye globale (ADP) et ERP (NetSuite), tout en soutenant l'exactitude des données qui sous-tendent nos processus de planification financière. Vous serez l'expert qui s'assurera que les opérations de paye fonctionnent avec précision et conformité dans nos entités mondiales. Vous conserverez NetSuite comme notre système financier fiable et collaborerez avec l'équipe des Finances sur les flux de données qui alimentent la planification et la production de rapports. Comme Sonar continue d'évoluer, votre travail s'améliorera directement Ce que vous ferez Vous êtes à l'aise de posséder l'administration de nos principales plateformes financières et de paie — ADP et NetSuite — pour une organisation multinationale en croissance rapide. Vous veillez à ce que les processus de paye soient exacts et conformes, à ce que le PGI fonctionne bien et à ce que les flux de données soient pris en charge par notre équipe des finances. Administration des systèmes de paye (ADP)
• Posséder l'administration de bout en bout et la configuration d'ADP (La force de travail maintenant préférée), en assurant le traitement de la paye en temps opportun, exact et conforme à plusieurs entités.
• Gérer l'accès, les rôles et la gouvernance des utilisateurs dans le PDA; coordonner avec les RH et les Finances les cycles de paye, les changements au compte et les exigences réglementaires en matière de conformité.
• Maintenir et améliorer l'intégration des données entre ADP et NetSuite, en veillant à ce que les entrées des journaux de paie, les dossiers des employés et les allocations de coûts circulent avec exactitude et en temps opportun.
• Résoudre les écarts de paye, gérer la relation avec le soutien du PDA et coordonner les mises à jour et les versions du système. Gestion nette du PGI
• Administrez et maintenez l'instance NetSuite : gestion des utilisateurs, rôles et autorisations, workflows, recherches sauvegardées et configurations de modules (P2P, Multi-book, Intercompany, etc.).
• Soutenir les activités de clôture de fin de mois et veiller à ce que NetSuite reste le système fiable pour les faits financiers réels.
• Diriger les processus de gestion du changement – documenter, mettre à l'essai et déployer les changements de système avec des contrôles appropriés et des évaluations d'impact.
• Soutenir les exigences de conformité des systèmes financiers en matière de contrôles généraux de la TI (ITGC) et de SOX. Soutien à la planification financière et à l'établissement de rapports
• Collaborer avec l'équipe des Finances pour s'assurer que nos outils FP&A (p. ex. le Pigment ou l'équivalent) contiennent les données réelles de NetSuite avec exactitude et à temps.
• Élaborer une compréhension fonctionnelle des processus des FP&A — budgétisation, prévisions mobiles et analyse des écarts — pour appuyer la validation des données et les besoins en matière de rapports ponctuels.
• Contribuer à l'intégration et à la qualité des données entre NetSuite et les plateformes de planification financière selon les besoins. Expérience et qualifications Expérience et acuité technique
• Administration des états de paie (obligatoire) : 5 ans et plus d'expérience pratique dans l'administration des PDA (maintenant préférée de la force de travail), y compris la configuration, les processus de traitement des états de paie, la conformité et l'intégration des systèmes.
• Administration NetSuite (obligatoire) : 5 ans ou plus d'administration NetSuite dans un environnement multi-entités ou multi-national ; la certification NetSuite Administrator est un plus.
• Connaissance des processus FP&A (budgétaire, prévision, analyse de la variance) et exposition à au moins un outil FP&A ou EPM (Pigment, Anaplan, Planification adaptative, ou similaire); une expertise pratique approfondie n'est pas nécessaire.
• Expérience pratique avec l'intégration de données entre les systèmes de paie, RH et financiers via l'API ou les connecteurs natifs.
• Expérience à l'appui des contrôles internes (GCTI) et de la conformité SOX dans tous les systèmes financiers.
• Bonus : expérience avec Carta, FloQast, BambooHR ou Aptitude.
• Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finances ou un domaine connexe. Leadership et compétences souples
• De façon détaillée et très organisée, avec une forte appropriation de l'exactitude de la paye et de l'intégrité des données.
• Autonome et pragmatique — à l'aise dans des environnements à croissance rapide avec ambiguïté et priorités concurrentes.
• Communication claire, efficace avec les partenaires financiers, RH et techniques.
• La collaboration et le partage des connaissances par nature; les valeurs de la prestation interfonctionnelle.
• Les valeurs « ont été » plutôt que « parfaites », tout en cherchant continuellement des moyens d'améliorer les processus et d'obtenir un impact mesurable. Commentaires supplémentaires Ce rôle est basé à Genève. Nous ne sommes pas en mesure de considérer les candidats qui ne veulent pas être à Genève, mais nous sommes prêts à déplacer le bon candidat. Culture interne On est intentionnels. Nous croyons que les meilleures équipes sont construites dans la pièce ensemble. Trois jours d'ancrage — les lundis, les mardis et les jeudis — créent le rythme de collaboration qui rend un bureau central intéressant. Les candidats doivent être vraiment basés dans l'endroit où le rôle est affiché — si ce n'est pas là où vous êtes aujourd'hui, nous sommes heureux d'appuyer la réinstallation pour la bonne personne. Nous apprécions la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion Chez Sonar, nous croyons que notre diversité est notre force. Nous sommes une entreprise mondiale qui valorise et respecte différents horizons, perspectives et cultures. Nous sommes déterminés à favoriser un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif où chacun se sent valorisé et habilité à contribuer le mieux possible. Nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur sur un pied d'égalité et d'accueillir tous les candidats qualifiés, peu importe la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l'identité ou l'expression de genre, l'orientation sexuelle, l'origine nationale, la génétique, le handicap, l'âge ou le statut de vétéran. Si vous avez besoin d'un logement, veuillez communiquer avec nous à l'adresse embauche@sonarsource.com . Toutes les offres d'emploi chez Sonar dépendent des résultats d'une vérification complète des antécédents et des références effectuée avant la date de début. Les demandes présentées par des organismes ou des tiers recruteurs ne seront pas prises en considération.

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
 SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
 SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
 SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
 Committed to our customers and community.

•
 Obsessed with quality.

•
 Deliberate in our decisions.

•
 Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do Daily:

• Generate new leads and opportunities within an assigned account set, representing our high-potential customer base at Sonar via upselling and cross-selling which enables you to exceed your revenue targets on a quarterly and yearly basis.

• Take ownership of your book of business: document the buying criteria, the buying process, the next steps and owners, and ensure pipeline accuracy based on evidence.

• Ensure that minimum requirements are established, managed and maintained with customers, such as quarterly business reviews.

• Onboard customers throughout their entire journey with SonarSource commercial products.

• Develop relationships with champions within existing customer accounts.

• Size and quote customer software license needs.

• Negotiate and close upgrades to existing implementations.

• Interact with customers over phone, email, video conference, and on-site meetings when necessary.

• Support marketing efforts with account-based customer-focused marketing campaigns.

• Pro-actively engage in building, growing and sharing sales team best practices.

• Accurately capture and report all aspects of account and opportunity information within the SFDC platform.

• Utilize Salesforce.com to set daily activity and accurately forecast opportunity pipeline.

The Experience You Will Need:

• Proven successful 5+ years of experience in a B2B sales role, ideally in a SaaS or subscription model.

• Focus on building and managing customer relationships.

• Experience selling a technical product to a technical buyer.

• Proven expertise in account planning and prospecting, using various channels and tools for prospecting, such as Zoominfo, LinkedIn, calling and networking.

• Expertise in navigating and growing a pipeline in existing customer accounts and taking a deal from Lead Qualification to Closed Won.

• Familiarity in supporting and selling to large enterprise customers and managing and negotiating enterprise deals.

• Ability to drive the sales process effectively through phone calls, emails, and virtual and on-site meetings.

• Proficiency in communicating with executive-level contacts and delivering value messages based on the persona you are engaging with (bottom/up and top/down approach).

• Salesforce.com lover; you know it and can’t imagine sales without it.

• Customer-Centric focus; We Want Happy Customers.

• Written and spoken Italian and English at a professional level.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi è Sonar? Sonar sta guidando il futuro dello sviluppo software agente-centrico. Come leader nella revisione e nella verifica del codice AI, risolviamo un problema critico: garantire che il software generato da sviluppatori assistiti da AI o agenti autonomi sia affidabile, sicuro e manutenbile. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità con Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini e Devin, aiutiamo oltre il 75% del software Fortune 100 costruire affidabile, affidabile, conforme. I clienti che utilizzano Sonar sono il 44% meno probabilità di segnalare un outage a causa del codice generato dall'IA. Crediamo che la verifica del codice sia il collegamento mancante fondamentale nel Ciclo di Sviluppo Agent-Centric (AC/DC). giganti del settore come Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca e Ford Motor Company. contare su di noi per fornire una revisione indipendente, spiegabile, coerente e la governance del loro codice generato dall'IA tramite prodotti come:
• SonarQube: la piattaforma leader mondiale per la revisione e la verifica del codice AI.
• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Attualmente il lancio delle classifiche per la riparazione di software agentic.
• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Fornire il contesto di livello enterprise e gli agenti vincoli devono essere veramente efficaci. Il nostro team opera in tutto il mondo a Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Ginevra, Londra, Singapore, Tokyo e Washington D.C. Ci muoviamo con una mentalità che chiamiamo CODE:
• Impegnati ai nostri clienti e comunità.
• Obsessed con qualità.
• Deliberate nelle nostre decisioni.
• Efficace come una squadra. Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari di ricavi e crescita redditizia e rapida, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione software AI. Se hai fame di avere un impatto, vuoi costruire ad un ritmo veloce, e pronto a lavorare in prima linea di AI, vogliamo sentire da te. Cosa farai ogni giorno:
• Genera nuovi lead e opportunità all'interno di un account assegnato, che rappresenta la nostra base clienti ad alto potenziale a Sonar tramite upselling e cross-selling che consente di superare i vostri obiettivi di fatturato su base trimestrale e annuale.
• Prendere la proprietà del vostro libro di affari: documentare i criteri di acquisto, il processo di acquisto, i prossimi passi e proprietari, e garantire l'accuratezza delle tubazioni in base alle prove.
• Assicurarsi che i requisiti minimi siano stabiliti, gestiti e mantenuti con i clienti, come le recensioni trimestrali aziendali.
• I clienti a bordo durante tutto il loro viaggio con prodotti commerciali SonarSource.
• Sviluppare relazioni con i campioni all'interno dei clienti esistenti.
• Dimensione e citazione delle esigenze di licenza del software del cliente.
• Negoziare e chiudere gli aggiornamenti alle implementazioni esistenti.
• Interagire con i clienti per telefono, e-mail, videoconferenza e riunioni in loco quando necessario.
• Sostenere gli sforzi di marketing con campagne di marketing orientate al cliente basate sul conto.
• Impegnarsi attivamente nella costruzione, la crescita e la condivisione delle migliori pratiche del team di vendita.
• Accuratamente catturare e segnalare tutti gli aspetti delle informazioni di account e opportunità all'interno della piattaforma SFDC.
• Utilizzare Salesforce.com per impostare l'attività quotidiana e prevedere con precisione la pipeline di opportunità. L'esperienza di cui avrete bisogno:
• Provato successo 5+ anni di esperienza in un ruolo di vendita B2B, idealmente in un SaaS o modello di abbonamento.
• Concentrati sulla costruzione e la gestione delle relazioni con i clienti.
• Esperienza di vendita di un prodotto tecnico a un acquirente tecnico.
• Provata esperienza nella pianificazione e nella prospettiva del conto, utilizzando vari canali e strumenti per la prospettiva, come Zoominfo, LinkedIn, chiamata e networking.
• Competenza nella navigazione e nella crescita di una pipeline nei conti dei clienti esistenti e prendendo un accordo da Lead Qualification a Closed Won.
• Familiarità nel sostenere e vendere a grandi clienti aziendali e gestire e negoziare affari aziendali.
• Capacità di guidare il processo di vendita in modo efficace attraverso telefonate, e-mail e riunioni virtuali e on-site.
• La competenza nel comunicare con i contatti esecutivi e fornire messaggi di valore basati sulla persona con cui si sta impegnando (approccio basso/alto e top/down).
• Salesforce.com amante; lo conosci e non puoi immaginare le vendite senza di essa.
• Concentrazione del cliente; Vogliamo i clienti felici.
• Scritto e parlato italiano e inglese a livello professionale. Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture. Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono valorizzati e potenziati per contribuire al meglio. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e di accogliere tutti i candidati qualificati, indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere o espressione, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, genetica, disabilità, età, o stato veterano. Se avete bisogno di un alloggio, contattateci all'indirizzo hiring@sonarsource.com . Tutte le offerte di lavoro a Sonar sono contingenti sui risultati di un controllo completo di sfondo e verifica di riferimento effettuato prima della data di inizio. Le domande che vengono presentate tramite agenzie o reclutatori di terze parti non saranno considerate.
