jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do Daily:

• Generate new opportunities within a dedicated portfolio of the most strategic financial and retail accounts through upselling and cross-selling.

• Lead strategic client engagements, including Quarterly Business Reviews, demonstrating how our solutions help them meet critical compliance standards like DORA, the CRA, and OWASP.

• Develop deep relationships with technical and business champions, becoming their go-to expert on clean code and application security.

• Articulate the value of advanced features, including the application of AI to secure coding, to differentiate our offerings and solve complex customer problems.

• Size, quote, negotiate, and close enterprise-level upgrades, managing the entire sales cycle with precision.

• Collaborate with marketing to create and execute targeted campaigns that resonate with the specific pain points of the banking and retail industries.

• Proactively share insights and best practices for selling into regulated markets with the wider sales team.

• Maintain meticulous records of account activity and opportunity forecasting using Salesforce.

The Experience You Will Need:

• Advantageous: Experience in or a strong understanding of Secure DevOps principles and how security is integrated into the modern software development lifecycle & knowledge of the application of AI in enhancing code security and the ability to discuss its benefits with technical audiences.

• Essential: A solid understanding of key compliance and security standards crucial to the finance and retail sectors, including the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and the OWASP Top 10.

• Proven success over 7+ years in a B2B SaaS sales role, with a track record of selling technical products to technical buyers and executive sponsors.

• Expertise in managing and growing large enterprise accounts, including navigating complex sales cycles and negotiating deals over £250k, while maintaining a run rate of incremental expansion revenue of 120k/month at an ASP of 25k. We are a high velocity business.

• Mastery of account planning, strategic prospecting, and pipeline management from lead qualification to closing the deal.

• Exceptional communication and listening skills, with the ability to deliver compelling value propositions to C-level contacts and handle objections effectively.

• Proficiency with Salesforce is a must; you should see it as a critical tool for success.

• A proactive, customer-centric, and team-oriented attitude with a professional level of written and spoken English. A build it while flying it attitude is essential.

• Experience of hypergrowth it’s challenges and opportunities is an advantage.

• Has worked in secure Devops familiarity with key concepts and standards governing code quality and security.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
 SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
 SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
 SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
 Committed to our customers and community.

•
 Obsessed with quality.

•
 Deliberate in our decisions.

•
 Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

We are entering a transformative era: the shift toward an Agentic SDLC, where AI agents and humans collaborate seamlessly to build better software. As a Software Engineer on this squad, you will help keep our high-scale integration infrastructure reliable and evolving, while beginning to explore how these same connective systems will serve the next generation of AI-driven workflows.

What you will do

•
 Deliver Features on the Integration Core. You will implement well-scoped backend features that keep our DevOps Platform integrations reliable and extensible — repository importing, binding, authentication, and webhook processing.

•
 Own Your Code from Local to Cloud. You will write clean, testable Java code and own your work from local development to production. You are responsible for the full lifecycle of the features you build. You will deploy to AWS, monitor service health through metrics and logs, and troubleshoot production issues to maintain high availability for our users.

•
 Enable Other Squads. You will contribute to the libraries and APIs that other engineering teams use to interact with DevOps platforms. Small improvements here have a multiplying effect across the organization.

•
 Contribute to Agentic Workflow Features. As the squad expands its integration surface to serve AI agents, you will contribute to these new capabilities — helping build and test the connectors and APIs that allow agents to consume Sonar context and act within DevOps platforms, building practical experience with emerging patterns like MCP.

•
 AI-Native Engineering. Use AI assistants pragmatically to speed up low-level tasks (boilerplate, refactorings, test scaffolding) while keeping full responsibility for architecture and quality.

•
 Collaborate & Grow. You will review PRs, write documentation, and participate in design discussions. You will learn from staff engineers on the squad and contribute your own perspective as you build expertise in your domain.

Experience and qualifications

•
 Strong CS Fundamentals. You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science (or related field). You have a solid grasp of Algorithms, Data Structures, and Complexity Analysis.

•
 Polyglot Potential (Java & Python & Typescript). You are proficient in at least one major language (Java or Python is a plus) and are eager to work in a hybrid environment. You care about code style, modularity, and writing clean, testable logic.

•
 Curiosity for Systems. You understand the basics of how computers talk to each other (HTTP, API basics, Linux environment). You might not be an AWS expert yet, but you are eager to learn how to build distributed systems in the cloud.

•
 Interest in AI/LLMs. You have a genuine interest in the AI space. You may have taken university courses on ML, experimented with OpenAI APIs in hackathons, or written a thesis involving NLP. You are excited to apply this to real-world engineering problems.

•
 Analytical Mindset. You are not satisfied with "it works on my machine." You want to understand how things work under the hood and enjoy digging into data to understand why a system behaves the way it does.

Our Technical Stack

•
 Languages: Java (Primary), Python (AWS CDK), TypeScript and React (integrations, frontend)

•
 Infrastructure: AWS (Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, SQS, RDS etc), Docker

•
 Integrations: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Jira, Slack

•
 Principles: Pragmatic code, SOLID, TDD, distributed systems

Additional comments
 This role is based in Geneva, Switzerland . We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva , but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

Benefits

• We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations with 27 PTO days for our employees based out of the Geneva region, plus additional days based on seniority and circumstances.

• We contribute 60% of the total cost for your pension; 13.5% to 15.5% of your base salary for savings; 2% for risk.

• Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually.

• Commuting:Sustainable mobility options, including carpooling and the refund of 60% of the annual transportation subscription.

• Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities.

• We have an annual kick-off somewhere in the world where we meet to build relationships and goals for the company.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

• Obsessed con qualità.
• Deliberate nelle nostre decisioni.
• Efficace come una squadra. Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari di ricavi e crescita redditizia e rapida, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione software AI. Se hai fame di avere un impatto, vuoi costruire ad un ritmo veloce, e pronto a lavorare in prima linea di AI, vogliamo sentire da te. Descrizione della posizione Stiamo entrando in un'era trasformativa: lo spostamento verso un SDLC Agentic, in cui agenti e esseri umani AI collaborano senza soluzione di continuità per costruire un software migliore. Come Ingegnere di software su questa squadra, vi aiuterà a mantenere la nostra infrastruttura di integrazione su larga scala affidabile e in evoluzione, mentre inizia a esplorare come questi stessi sistemi connettivi servirà la prossima generazione di flussi di lavoro basati su AI. Cosa farai
• Fornire funzionalità sul nucleo di integrazione. Potrai implementare funzionalità backend ben visualizzate che mantengono le nostre integrazioni DevOps Platform affidabili ed estensibili — importazione di repository, binding, autenticazione e elaborazione webhook.
• Own Your Code da Locale a Cloud. Scriverai codice Java pulito e testabile e possiederai il tuo lavoro dallo sviluppo locale alla produzione. Sei responsabile del ciclo di vita completo delle caratteristiche che si costruisce. Si distribuirà a AWS, monitorare la salute dei servizi attraverso metriche e registri, e risolvere problemi di produzione per mantenere alta disponibilità per i nostri utenti.
• Attivare altre squadre. Contribuirai alle librerie e alle API che altri team di ingegneria utilizzano per interagire con le piattaforme DevOps. Piccoli miglioramenti qui hanno un effetto moltiplicatore in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Contribuisci alle funzionalità del flusso di lavoro agente. Poiché la squadra espande la sua superficie di integrazione per servire agenti AI, contribuirà a queste nuove funzionalità - aiutando a costruire e testare i connettori e le API che permettono agli agenti di consumare il contesto Sonar e agire all'interno di piattaforme DevOps, costruendo esperienza pratica con modelli emergenti come MCP.
• AI-Native Engineering. Utilizzare assistenti AI pragmaticamente per accelerare i compiti di basso livello (boilerplate, refactoring, test ponteggio) mantenendo la piena responsabilità per l'architettura e la qualità.
• Collaborare e crescere. Potrai rivedere PR, scrivere documentazione e partecipare a discussioni di progettazione. Imparerai dagli ingegneri del personale della squadra e contribuirai alla tua prospettiva mentre costruirai competenze nel tuo dominio. Esperienza e qualifiche
• Forti Fondamenti CS. Hai una laurea o master in Informatica (o campo relativo). Hai una solida conoscenza di Algoritmi, Strutture Dati e Analisi Complessità.
• Potenziale poliglotta (Java & Python & Typescript). Sei abile in almeno una lingua importante (Java o Python è un plus) e sono desiderosi di lavorare in un ambiente ibrido. Ti interessa lo stile del codice, la modularità e la scrittura di logica pulita e testabile.
• Curiosità per i Sistemi. Capisci le basi di come i computer si parlano a vicenda (HTTP, basi API, ambiente Linux). Potresti non essere ancora un esperto AWS, ma sei ansioso di imparare a costruire sistemi distribuiti nel cloud.
• Interessi in AI/LLMs. Hai un vero interesse per lo spazio AI. Si può aver preso corsi universitari su ML, sperimentato con OpenAI API in hackathons, o scritto una tesi che coinvolge NLP. Sei entusiasta di applicare questo a problemi di ingegneria del mondo reale.
• Mindset analitico. Non sei soddisfatto di "lavora sulla mia macchina". Si desidera capire come le cose funzionano sotto il cofano e godere di scavare nei dati per capire perché un sistema si comporta come fa. Il nostro Stack Tecnico
• Lingue: Java (Primary), Python (AWS CDK), TypeScript e React (integrazione, frontend)
• Infrastrutture: AWS (Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, SQS, RDS ecc), Docker
• Integrazioni: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Jira, Slack
• Principi: Codice Pragmatico, SOLID, TDD, sistemi distribuiti Ulteriori commenti Questo ruolo ha sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera . Non siamo in grado di considerare i candidati che non vogliono essere a Ginevra, ma siamo disposti a trasferire il candidato giusto. Vantaggi
• Incoraggiamo l'utilizzo delle nostre robuste assegnazioni time-off con 27 giorni PTO per i nostri dipendenti con sede nella regione di Ginevra, oltre a giorni aggiuntivi basati su anzianità e circostanze.
• Contribuiamo il 60% del costo totale per la vostra pensione; il 13,5% al 15,5% del vostro stipendio base per il risparmio; il 2% per il rischio.
• Generoso discrezionale Company Growth Bonus, pagato annualmente.
• Commutazione: opzioni di mobilità sostenibile, tra cui carpooling e il rimborso del 60% dell'abbonamento annuale di trasporto.
• La forza lavoro globale con i dipendenti in 20+ paesi che rappresentano 35+ nazionalità uniche.
• Abbiamo un kick-off annuale da qualche parte nel mondo in cui ci incontriamo per costruire relazioni e obiettivi per l'azienda. Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture. Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono valorizzati e potenziati per contribuire al meglio. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e di accogliere tutti i candidati qualificati, indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere o espressione, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, genetica, disabilità, età, o stato veterano. Se avete bisogno di un alloggio, contattateci all'indirizzo hiring@sonarsource.com . Tutte le offerte di lavoro a Sonar sono contingenti sui risultati di un controllo completo di sfondo e verifica di riferimento effettuato prima della data di inizio. Le domande che vengono presentate tramite agenzie o reclutatori di terze parti non saranno considerate.

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
 SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
 SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
 SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
 Committed to our customers and community.

•
 Obsessed with quality.

•
 Deliberate in our decisions.

•
 Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

Our website is the front door to the Sonar ecosystem. It is where developers and organizations discover our products, and where our marketing and data systems connect to the outside world. You will work across both sides of that: building the UI people see and the integrations they do not.

You will start by contributing across the full stack and progressively own entire domains end-to-end:

• UI delivery: Build accessible, performant components from design specs for a growing number of websites that serve a global audience across 7 languages.

• Analytics & tracking: Own how we instrument the websites (event tracking, data layer, tag management) so that marketing and product teams can measure what matters.

• Marketing integrations: Own the backend connections between our frontend and our business systems (forms, lead capture, automation workflows) ensuring data flows accurately from the browser to internal tools.

We have built our development workflow around AI-assisted coding and we expect you to push that further. AI handles more of the repetitive work over time, which means your role expands into higher-impact territory, not less.

What you will do

•
 Build UI components from Figma designs, collaborating closely with designers to iterate until it’s right.

•
 Write and maintain content model migrations as our CMS structure evolves.

•
 Implement tracking requirements from the marketing team, including new events, data layer updates, and tag configuration.

•
 Build and maintain the server-side logic that powers forms, API routes, and integrations with external marketing systems.

•
 Partner with the SEO and content teams on structured data, metadata, and internationalization.

•
 Write tests, read code reviews, provide honest feedback and ship code.

•
 Leverage AI coding tools daily, as a core part of your engineering workflow.

Experience and qualifications

•
 4+ years of professional web development: Hands-on expertise in TypeScript, React, and Node.js is required.

•
 Quality-minded: You write tested code and care about what ships to production. Experience with modern testing tools and CI workflows.

•
 Comfortable on the backend: You have built API routes, handled form submissions server-side, or worked with external service integrations. You’re not afraid of a server loader.

•
 Curious about web analytics: Experience with tag management (GTM) or analytics instrumentation.

•
 AI-fluent: You actively use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot...) in your daily workflow and look for ways to go further.

•
 Pragmatic and Autonomous: You prioritize impact over technical novelty. You do not wait for direction, you investigate, form an opinion, take action, and iterate as you learn.

Nice to have:

•
 Experience with a framework (Remix, Next.js, React Router framework mode), Tailwind CSS, a headless CMS, or Storybook.

•
 Experience with analytics tools (other than Google): Mixpanel, Fullstory

•
 Experience with CRMs: SalesForce, Marketing Cloud

Additional comments
 This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
Committed to our customers and community.

•
Obsessed with quality.

•
Deliberate in our decisions.

•
Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

Our website is the front door to the Sonar ecosystem. It is where developers and organizations discover our products, and where our marketing and data systems connect to the outside world. You will work across both sides of that: building the UI people see and the integrations they do not.

You will start by contributing across the full stack and progressively own entire domains end-to-end:

• UI delivery: Build accessible, performant components from design specs for a growing number of websites that serve a global audience across 7 languages.

• Analytics & tracking: Own how we instrument the websites (event tracking, data layer, tag management) so that marketing and product teams can measure what matters.

• Marketing integrations: Own the backend connections between our frontend and our business systems (forms, lead capture, automation workflows) ensuring data flows accurately from the browser to internal tools.

We have built our development workflow around AI-assisted coding and we expect you to push that further. AI handles more of the repetitive work over time, which means your role expands into higher-impact territory, not less.

What you will do

•
Build UI components from Figma designs, collaborating closely with designers to iterate until it’s right.

•
Write and maintain content model migrations as our CMS structure evolves.

•
Implement tracking requirements from the marketing team, including new events, data layer updates, and tag configuration.

•
Build and maintain the server-side logic that powers forms, API routes, and integrations with external marketing systems.

•
Partner with the SEO and content teams on structured data, metadata, and internationalization.

•
Write tests, read code reviews, provide honest feedback and ship code.

•
Leverage AI coding tools daily, as a core part of your engineering workflow.

Experience and qualifications

•
4+ years of professional web development: Hands-on expertise in TypeScript, React, and Node.js is required.

•
Quality-minded: You write tested code and care about what ships to production. Experience with modern testing tools and CI workflows.

•
Comfortable on the backend: You have built API routes, handled form submissions server-side, or worked with external service integrations. You’re not afraid of a server loader.

•
Curious about web analytics: Experience with tag management (GTM) or analytics instrumentation.

•
AI-fluent: You actively use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot...) in your daily workflow and look for ways to go further.

•
Pragmatic and Autonomous: You prioritize impact over technical novelty. You do not wait for direction, you investigate, form an opinion, take action, and iterate as you learn.

Nice to have:

•
Experience with a framework (Remix, Next.js, React Router framework mode), Tailwind CSS, a headless CMS, or Storybook.

•
Experience with analytics tools (other than Google): Mixpanel, Fullstory

•
Experience with CRMs: SalesForce, Marketing Cloud

Additional comments
This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

jobs.title: Deal Desk Specialist - (Contractor)
jobs.description:
Position description

As a Deal Desk Specialist at Sonar, you will have the unique opportunity to contribute to the transformation of our business and how we support our sales teams.

In this role, you will partner with our sales teams daily with a core focus on driving deal velocity, collaborating with internal stakeholders, and helping to establish a culture of continuous improvement. Your expertise and strategic insights will be key in optimizing the sales process while functioning as a hub for all deal activity that will impact Sonar’s quote to cash (Q2C) operations.

This role will also have an impact on key metrics that support Sonar’s business goals and objectives and will play an essential part in maintaining streamlined processes and facilitating successful business outcomes.

This is a temporary position until end of December 2026.

What you will do

Deal Strategy and Processing

•
 Proactively engage with sales teams on committed pipeline deals.

•
 Generate standard and complex quotes using the CPQ system, based on customer needs and pricing guidelines.

•
 Review deal support activities to ensure adherence to sales, finance, and legal policies.

•
 Facilitate and optimize approval workflows for Order Forms and contracts to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

•
 Collaborate with sales to understand deal specifics and aid in qualification to resolve potential issues.

•
 Provide timely responses to deal-related inquiries via cases, Slack, or email within defined SLAs.

•
 Draft, review, and finalize necessary documentation for deal execution.

•
 Maintain the highest standards of data integrity in Salesforce (SFDC) by updating account information, contacts, and opportunity statuses comprehensively.

•
 Address and resolve any issues or discrepancies related to deals and contracts effectively, mitigating risks.

•
 Structure deals to meet revenue recognition standards and guidelines, ensuring financial accuracy and compliance.

Sales Team Enablement and Process Improvement

•
 Provide training and support to sales teams on deal desk processes and best practices, enhancing best practices for deal support.

•
 Offer feedback on strategies to improve customer satisfaction and streamline the deal process.

Additional Responsibilities

•
 Assist with projects and other tasks as required.

•
 Provide extended support during End of Month (EOM) and End of Quarter (EOQ) periods to meet business demands.

Experience and qualifications

•
 Deal Desk/Sales Operations/ Renewal Operations Expertise:

•
 An understanding of sales support operations processes and systems.

•
 Experience in supporting sales pipeline and deal progression.

•
 Strong understanding of sales processes and pricing strategies.

•
 Detail-oriented with a focus on data integrity and compliance.

•
 Quoting and Pricing Strategy:

•
 Proficiency in crafting accurate and complex quotes.

•
 Knowledge of general pricing strategies to maximize revenue and customer LifeTimeValue (LTV).

•
 Contract Management:

•
 Familiarity with drafting and reviewing contracts.

•
 Ability to ensure compliance with sales, finance and legal policies.

•
 Ability to resolve issues efficiently and support revenue recognition standards.

•
 Analytical Skills:

•
 Strong analytical abilities to interpret complex data and metrics.

•
 Capability to generate actionable insights to support decision-making.

•
 Technical Proficiency:

•
 Proficient in CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and CPQ tools.

•
 Ability to leverage technology to streamline processes and improve efficiency.

•
 Effective Communication:

•
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills for internal and external interactions.

•
 Ability to articulate strategies and solutions clearly to stakeholders.

•
 Cross-Functional Collaboration:

•
 Proven track record of working collaboratively with sales, finance, legal, and other teams.

•
 Build and maintain strong relationships across departments.

•
 Experience in conducting training sessions and providing continuous support to sales teams.

• Offrire feedback sulle strategie per migliorare la soddisfazione del cliente e semplificare il processo di offerta. Responsabilità aggiuntive
• Assistere con progetti e altre attività come richiesto.
• Fornire un supporto esteso durante i periodi di fine mese (EOM) e fine del trimestre (EOQ) per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali. Esperienza e qualifiche
• Operazioni di banco/vendita/ operazioni di rinnovo
• Una comprensione dei processi e dei sistemi operativi di supporto alle vendite.
• Esperienza nel sostenere la pipeline di vendita e affrontare la progressione.
• Forte comprensione dei processi di vendita e strategie di prezzi.
• Dettaglio orientato con un focus sull'integrità e la conformità dei dati.
• Strategia di citazione e prezzi:
• Competenza nella realizzazione di citazioni accurate e complesse.
• Conoscenza delle strategie generali di prezzi per massimizzare le entrate e il cliente LifeTimeValue (LTV).
• Gestione dei contratti:
• Familiarità con la redazione e la revisione dei contratti.
• Capacità di garantire il rispetto delle politiche di vendita, finanza e legale.
• Capacità di risolvere i problemi in modo efficiente e sostenere gli standard di riconoscimento delle entrate.
• Abilità analitiche:
• Forte capacità analitiche di interpretare dati e metriche complessi.
• Capacità di generare intuizioni attuabili per sostenere il processo decisionale.
• Competenza tecnica:
• Proficiente nei sistemi CRM (Salesforce preferito) e strumenti CPQ.
• Capacità di sfruttare la tecnologia per ottimizzare i processi e migliorare l'efficienza.
• Comunicazione efficace:
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale per interazioni interne ed esterne.
• Capacità di articolare strategie e soluzioni chiaramente agli stakeholder.
• Collaborazione trasversale:
• Provato record di lavoro in collaborazione con vendite, finanza, legale e altre squadre.
• Costruire e mantenere forti relazioni tra i reparti.
• Esperienza nella conduzione di sessioni formative e supporto continuo ai team di vendita.

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
 SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
 SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
 SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
 Committed to our customers and community.

•
 Obsessed with quality.

•
 Deliberate in our decisions.

•
 Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

This role is the data team's dedicated analytical partner for Marketing. Your core job is to turn marketing data into decisions: diagnose what is working and what is not, explain why, and recommend where to spend the next dollar. You will own marketing attribution, ROI, and conversion analysis end to end, and you will be proactive about it, surfacing findings and opportunities before anyone asks.

You will explore data, form hypotheses, and partner with our Data and Analytics Engineers to shape the models and pipelines you need. You will help define those models, but your primary measure of success is the quality and impact of your analysis.

This role sits in the Data & Insights team and partners closely with Marketing, IT/Marketing Ops, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, and data scientists covering other domains.

What you will do

•
 Drive marketing decisions with analysis. Own attribution, ROI, conversion, and funnel analysis. Diagnose drops and anomalies, quantify what drives them, and translate findings into clear recommendations for marketing leaders.

•
 Optimize marketing spend. Connect spend to outcomes across channels and campaigns, and advise on where to invest, cut, or test next.

•
 Be proactive. Explore and correlate data to surface insights nobody asked for. Anticipate the next question. Bring opportunities to the marketing team rather than waiting for requests.

•
 Run experiments. Design and read out A/B tests and other experiments, applying sound statistical methods and being honest about significance and causality.

•
 Partner on the data foundation. Work hand in hand with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers to get marketing data into the warehouse and modeled. Define requirements, explore raw data, and contribute to data models that connect marketing data with sales and product data.

•
 Tell the story. Communicate insights so non-technical stakeholders can act, and document context, caveats, and decisions so the work survives handoffs.

Experience and qualifications

•
 Strong analytical track record: someone who has measurably influenced business or marketing decisions through analysis, not just produced reports.

•
 Comfort with the latest AI tools, and a habit of using them to work faster and sharper: exploring data, writing and debugging code, drafting analysis, and accelerating insight. You stay current as the tooling evolves and bring new approaches to the team.

•
 Eagerness to develop: you actively grow your skills, seek feedback, and treat new tools and methods as opportunities rather than threats.

•
 Solid SQL. You can independently query, join, and explore data without waiting for someone to prepare it for you.

•
 Proficiency in Python for analysis, modeling, and automation.

•
 Statistical foundation: experimentation, significance testing, regression, segmentation, forecasting, and the judgment to know which applies.

•
 Working knowledge of marketing and GTM data: channels, campaigns, attribution models, funnel and conversion metrics, and the realities of joining marketing data to CRM/sales and product usage data.

•
 Willingness to get hands-on with data modeling. You don't need to be a dbt expert, but you must be comfortable exploring messy data and partnering on (or building) the models you need rather than waiting for clean tables.

•
 Strong communication and stakeholder skills: you can challenge weak measurement respectfully and make a recommendation, not just present options.

•
 Proactivity and autonomy: you raise your hand early, plan your own work, and look for impact without being asked.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi è Sonar? Sonar sta guidando il futuro dello sviluppo software agente-centrico. Come leader nella verifica e nella governance del codice AI, risolviamo un problema critico: garantire che il software generato da sviluppatori assistiti da AI o agenti autonomi sia affidabile, sicuro e manutenbile. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità con Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini e Devin, aiutiamo oltre il 75% del software Fortune 100 costruire affidabile, affidabile, conforme. I clienti che utilizzano Sonar sono il 44% meno probabilità di segnalare un outage a causa del codice generato dall'IA. Crediamo che la verifica del codice sia il collegamento mancante fondamentale nel Ciclo di Sviluppo Agent-Centric (AC/DC). I giganti del settore come Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca e Ford Motor Company contano su di noi per fornire una revisione indipendente, spiegabile, coerente e la governance del loro codice generato dall'IA attraverso prodotti come:
• SonarQube: la piattaforma leader mondiale per la revisione e la verifica del codice AI.
• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Attualmente il lancio delle classifiche per la riparazione di software agentic.
• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Fornire il contesto di livello enterprise e gli agenti vincoli devono essere veramente efficaci. Il nostro team opera in tutto il mondo a Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Ginevra, Londra, Singapore, Tokyo e Washington D.C. Ci muoviamo con una mentalità che chiamiamo CODE:
• Impegnati ai nostri clienti e comunità.
• Obsessed con qualità.
• Deliberate nelle nostre decisioni.
• Efficace come una squadra. Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari di ricavi e crescita redditizia e rapida, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione software AI. Se hai fame di avere un impatto, vuoi costruire ad un ritmo veloce, e pronto a lavorare in prima linea di AI, vogliamo sentire da te. Descrizione della posizione Questo ruolo è il partner analitico dedicato del team di dati per il Marketing. Il vostro compito principale è quello di trasformare i dati di marketing in decisioni: diagnosticare ciò che funziona e ciò che non è, spiegare perché, e consigliare dove spendere il prossimo dollaro. Possiedi attribuzione di marketing, ROI e analisi di conversione finiscono alla fine, e sarete proattivi su di esso, navigando i risultati e le opportunità prima che qualcuno chiede. Esplorerai i dati, form ipotesi e partnerrai i nostri ingegneri di dati e analisi per modellare i modelli e le pipeline di cui hai bisogno. Ti aiuterà a definire quei modelli, ma la tua misura primaria di successo è la qualità e l'impatto della tua analisi. Questo ruolo si trova nel team di Data & Insights e collabora strettamente con Marketing, IT/Marketing Ops, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers e data sciences che coprono altri domini. Cosa farai
• Guidare le decisioni di marketing con l'analisi. Attribuzione personale, ROI, conversione e analisi imbuto. Diagnosi gocce e anomalie, quantificare ciò che li spinge, e tradurre i risultati in chiare raccomandazioni per i leader di marketing.
• Ottimizzare la spesa di marketing. Collegare spendere ai risultati attraverso canali e campagne, e consigliare su dove investire, tagliare, o testare dopo.
• Sii proattivo. Esplorare e correlare i dati per intuizioni di superficie nessuno richiesto. Anticipa la prossima domanda. Portare opportunità al team di marketing piuttosto che aspettare le richieste.
• Esegui esperimenti. Progettare e leggere i test A/B e altri esperimenti, applicare metodi statistici sonori ed essere onesti circa significato e causalità.
• Partner sulla base dei dati. Lavorare fianco a fianco con Data Engineers e Analytics Engineers per ottenere i dati di marketing nel magazzino e modellato. Definire i requisiti, esplorare i dati grezzi e contribuire a modelli di dati che collegano i dati di marketing con le vendite e i dati del prodotto.
• Racconta la storia. Comunicare intuizioni in modo che le parti interessate non tecniche possono agire, e documentare il contesto, le caveats e le decisioni in modo che il lavoro sopravviva ai handoff. Esperienza e qualifiche
• Forte record di traccia analitica: qualcuno che ha influenzato in modo misurabile le decisioni di business o marketing attraverso l'analisi, non solo ha prodotto rapporti.
• Comfort con gli ultimi strumenti AI, e l'abitudine di utilizzarli per lavorare più velocemente e più nitido: esplorare i dati, scrivere e debug codice, redigere analisi e accelerare la comprensione. Si rimane corrente come lo strumento si evolve e portare nuovi approcci alla squadra.
• Impazienza di sviluppare: coltivate attivamente le vostre abilità, cercate feedback, e trattate nuovi strumenti e metodi come opportunità piuttosto che minacce.
• Solid SQL. È possibile query indipendentemente, unire ed esplorare i dati senza aspettare qualcuno per prepararlo per voi.
• Proficienza in Python per analisi, modellazione e automazione.
• Fondazione statistica: sperimentazione, test di significato, regressione, segmentazione, previsione, e la sentenza di sapere che si applica.
• Conoscenze di lavoro di marketing e dati GTM: canali, campagne, modelli di attribuzione, imbuto e metriche di conversione, e le realtà di unire i dati di marketing a CRM / vendite e dati di utilizzo del prodotto.
• Volontà di ottenere hands-on con la modellazione dei dati. Non c'è bisogno di essere un esperto dbt, ma devi essere comodo esplorare i dati disordinati e collaborare su (o costruire) i modelli di cui hai bisogno piuttosto che aspettare tavoli puliti.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e stakeholder: è possibile sfidare la misura debole con rispetto e fare una raccomandazione, non solo le opzioni presenti.
• Proattività e autonomia: si alza la mano presto, pianificare il proprio lavoro, e cercare l'impatto senza essere chiesto. Cultura in ufficio Siamo intenzionali. Crediamo che le migliori squadre siano costruite nella stanza insieme. Tre giorni di ancora — lunedì, martedì e giovedì — creano il ritmo di collaborazione che rende un hub office degno di avere. I candidati devono essere autenticamente basati nel luogo in cui il ruolo è pubblicato — se non è lì che sei oggi, siamo lieti di sostenere la delocalizzazione per la persona giusta. Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture. Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono valorizzati e potenziati per contribuire al meglio. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e di accogliere tutti i candidati qualificati, indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere o espressione, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, genetica, disabilità, età, o stato veterano. Se avete bisogno di un alloggio, contattateci all'indirizzo hiring@sonarsource.com . Tutte le offerte di lavoro a Sonar sono contingenti sui risultati di un controllo completo di sfondo e verifica di riferimento effettuato prima della data di inizio. Le domande che vengono presentate tramite agenzie o reclutatori di terze parti non saranno considerate.

Experience and qualifications

•
Strong analytical track record: someone who has measurably influenced business or marketing decisions through analysis, not just produced reports.

•
Comfort with the latest AI tools, and a habit of using them to work faster and sharper: exploring data, writing and debugging code, drafting analysis, and accelerating insight. You stay current as the tooling evolves and bring new approaches to the team.

•
Eagerness to develop: you actively grow your skills, seek feedback, and treat new tools and methods as opportunities rather than threats.

•
Solid SQL. You can independently query, join, and explore data without waiting for someone to prepare it for you.

•
Proficiency in Python for analysis, modeling, and automation.

•
Statistical foundation: experimentation, significance testing, regression, segmentation, forecasting, and the judgment to know which applies.

•
Working knowledge of marketing and GTM data: channels, campaigns, attribution models, funnel and conversion metrics, and the realities of joining marketing data to CRM/sales and product usage data.

•
Willingness to get hands-on with data modeling. You don't need to be a dbt expert, but you must be comfortable exploring messy data and partnering on (or building) the models you need rather than waiting for clean tables.

•
Strong communication and stakeholder skills: you can challenge weak measurement respectfully and make a recommendation, not just present options.

•
Proactivity and autonomy: you raise your hand early, plan your own work, and look for impact without being asked.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
 SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
 SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
 SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
 Committed to our customers and community.

•
 Obsessed with quality.

•
 Deliberate in our decisions.

•
 Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

We want to make the best decisions possible for our products and to do that, we need to make data-driven decisions. To achieve this goal, we are looking for a talented Data Product Analyst (DPA) to join the product data team.

As a Data Product Analyst (DPA) at Sonar, you are the architect of clarity and the bridge between technical infrastructure and business value. We treat Data as a Product, and you own its entire lifecycle—from dbt SQL modeling and event-based schema governance to high-level executive storytelling.

You will thrive in this role if you enjoy a "full-stack" analytical challenge. You are a proactive project leader who owns the data relationship for your domain. Depending on the need, your impact ranges from empowering users through data literacy to leading complex, end-to-end analyses from initial conception to the final executive summary.

What you will do

We believe in using the best tools to stay effective and efficient. You will be expected to master and evolve our data ecosystem:

Data project ownership & delivery

•
 Managing a data project from start to finish using agile method, helping stakeholders to refine their questions into structured data projects, advising stakeholders on what to measure, how to model it, and which tool to use and facilitating stakeholder discussions to bridge the gap between high-level business goals and technical execution.

•
 Deliver end-to-end solutions, from ingestion and modeling to executive-ready visualizations and summaries.

Technical stack

•
 Modeling & Architecture: Build and maintain scalable models using dbt (SQL) and provide critical reviews of event schemas for our event-based platform.

•
 Modern Workflow: Leverage Cursor and Git to accelerate development and ensure code quality and version control.

•
 The Analytics Hub: Own the user experience across Mixpanel, Tableau, Metabase, and Atlan, ensuring they serve as the single source of truth.

Data literacy

•
 Onboarding and empowering users to self-serve, effectively reducing the data team as a bottleneck.

•
 Handling ad-hoc requests ranging from querying specific datasets to providing technical guidance on our tooling landscape.

•
 Participating in Level 1 technical support, including monitoring dbt jobs and Tableau extracts to ensure the reliability of our products.

•
 Project Governance: Use Jira for roadmap visibility and dbt/Confluence/Atlan for high-quality documentation that survives handoffs.

Continuous Platform Improvement

You act as a bridge to Data Engineering. You’ll proactively surface data debt, documentation gaps, and tooling friction to ensure the platform gets simpler and stronger over time. You’ll also ensure high standards for PII handling and security policies are built into every delivery.

Experience and qualifications

•
 Proven Experience: 3–5+ years in a Data Analyst, Data Product Analyst, or Analytics Engineering role, ideally within a fast-paced environment.

•
 Project Leadership: A track record of taking the lead with stakeholders—successfully translating high-level business ambiguity into structured, actionable data projects. You have experience helping and mentoring other team members.

•
 Technical Mastery: hands-on experience with dbt / SQL (modeling, testing, and documentation).

•
 Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Mixpanel, or similar)

•
 The Modern Workflow: Comfort working in a version-controlled environment (Git) and an interest in leveraging AI-assisted development tools (like Cursor) to drive efficiency.

•
 Data Storytelling: The ability to distill complex findings into executive-ready summaries and visualizations that drive decision-making.

•
 You are fluent in English both written and spoken

•
 Familiarity with data governance practices (PII handling and access control).

•
 Experience in Product Analytics or working directly with Product Managers a nice to have

•
 Familiarity with data engineering concepts (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, ETL / ELT pipeline) and tools (AWS, redshift, Lamdas, Databricks) is a plus

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

We do not currently support visa candidates in the US.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
Committed to our customers and community.

•
Obsessed with quality.

•
Deliberate in our decisions.

•
Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

We want to make the best decisions possible for our products and to do that, we need to make data-driven decisions. To achieve this goal, we are looking for a talented Data Product Analyst (DPA) to join the product data team.

As a Data Product Analyst (DPA) at Sonar, you are the architect of clarity and the bridge between technical infrastructure and business value. We treat Data as a Product, and you own its entire lifecycle—from dbt SQL modeling and event-based schema governance to high-level executive storytelling.

You will thrive in this role if you enjoy a "full-stack" analytical challenge. You are a proactive project leader who owns the data relationship for your domain. Depending on the need, your impact ranges from empowering users through data literacy to leading complex, end-to-end analyses from initial conception to the final executive summary.

What you will do

We believe in using the best tools to stay effective and efficient. You will be expected to master and evolve our data ecosystem:

Data project ownership & delivery

•
Managing a data project from start to finish using agile method, helping stakeholders to refine their questions into structured data projects, advising stakeholders on what to measure, how to model it, and which tool to use and facilitating stakeholder discussions to bridge the gap between high-level business goals and technical execution.

•
Deliver end-to-end solutions, from ingestion and modeling to executive-ready visualizations and summaries.

Technical stack

•
Modeling & Architecture: Build and maintain scalable models using dbt (SQL) and provide critical reviews of event schemas for our event-based platform.

•
Modern Workflow: Leverage Cursor and Git to accelerate development and ensure code quality and version control.

•
The Analytics Hub: Own the user experience across Mixpanel, Tableau, Metabase, and Atlan, ensuring they serve as the single source of truth.

Data literacy

•
Onboarding and empowering users to self-serve, effectively reducing the data team as a bottleneck.

•
Handling ad-hoc requests ranging from querying specific datasets to providing technical guidance on our tooling landscape.

•
Participating in Level 1 technical support, including monitoring dbt jobs and Tableau extracts to ensure the reliability of our products.

•
Project Governance: Use Jira for roadmap visibility and dbt/Confluence/Atlan for high-quality documentation that survives handoffs.

Continuous Platform Improvement

You act as a bridge to Data Engineering. You’ll proactively surface data debt, documentation gaps, and tooling friction to ensure the platform gets simpler and stronger over time. You’ll also ensure high standards for PII handling and security policies are built into every delivery.

Experience and qualifications

•
Proven Experience: 3–5+ years in a Data Analyst, Data Product Analyst, or Analytics Engineering role, ideally within a fast-paced environment.

•
Project Leadership: A track record of taking the lead with stakeholders—successfully translating high-level business ambiguity into structured, actionable data projects. You have experience helping and mentoring other team members.

•
Technical Mastery: hands-on experience with dbt / SQL (modeling, testing, and documentation).

•
Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Mixpanel, or similar)

•
The Modern Workflow: Comfort working in a version-controlled environment (Git) and an interest in leveraging AI-assisted development tools (like Cursor) to drive efficiency.

•
Data Storytelling: The ability to distill complex findings into executive-ready summaries and visualizations that drive decision-making.

•
You are fluent in English both written and spoken

•
Familiarity with data governance practices (PII handling and access control).

•
Experience in Product Analytics or working directly with Product Managers a nice to have

•
Familiarity with data engineering concepts (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, ETL / ELT pipeline) and tools (AWS, redshift, Lamdas, Databricks) is a plus

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

We do not currently support visa candidates in the US.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

At Sonar, we are seeking an innovative Research Engineer to join our Data & Agentic team and pioneer the next generation of our code analysis engine. You will be at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI, Large Language Model (LLM) and agentic techniques to the complex domain of source code. Your work will directly shape our products, pushing the boundaries of static analysis to help millions of developers write better, more secure code. If you are driven to solve real-world problems by turning state-of-the-art research into practical, high-impact solutions, this is the role for you.

What you will do

•
 Create & Innovate: Actively participate in the conceptualization phase. Brainstorm novel ways to improve our products and provide immediate, practical feedback to steer exploratory research toward paths that are both impactful and engineering-feasible.

•
 Develop Advanced AI Models : Design, prototype, and validate novel ML models that identify and resolve complex bugs, vulnerabilities, and code smells, going beyond the capabilities of traditional static analysis.

•
 Develop Pragmatic Prototypes: Build hands-on prototypes that prove the viability and scalability of research concepts. Proactively identify engineering bottlenecks or scalability limits and propose effective mitigations early in the research phase.

•
 Evaluate & Benchmark: Drive the rigorous evaluation of new AI-powered features. Construct high-quality datasets, define relevant success metrics, and implement comprehensive benchmarks leveraging Sonar’s existing IP alongside third-party and open-source AI tools.

•
 Engineer Data Pipelines : Build and manage robust data pipelines to gather, process, and version massive code-centric datasets required for training and evaluating specialized models at scale.

•
 Translate Prototypes to Products : Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful AI prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base.

•
 Communicate and Evangelize : Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience and qualifications

• Strong industry experience in AI and a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices and tools, with minimum 2 years experience in industry.

• Exceptional programming skills in Python (other programming languages such as Java is a strong plus), and the ability to write clean, well-documented code for product integration.

• Practical experience working with modern AI/ML frameworks, LLMs, and integrating third-party or open-source AI tools into functional prototypes.

• Proven experience in data handling: constructing high-quality datasets, defining objective success metrics, and building robust benchmarks for AI solutions.

• Experience with modern LLM architectures and techniques, such as:

• Fine-tuning strategies (e.g., LoRA, QLoRA) and advanced prompt engineering.

• Building and optimizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.

• Working with vector databases and semantic search.

• Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks and cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS).

• Experience of driving research projects from initial ideation to a demonstrable prototype with a high degree of autonomy.

• The ability to fast context-switch and maintain momentum across multiple concurrent, fast-moving research topics.

• Excellent communication skills in English, with a talent for translating complex research findings into clear, actionable artifacts for product engineering squads.

Additional comments

This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Come leader nella verifica e nella governance del codice AI, risolviamo un problema critico: garantire che il software generato da sviluppatori assistiti da AI o agenti autonomi sia affidabile, sicuro e manutenbile. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità con Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini e Devin, aiutiamo oltre il 75% del software Fortune 100 costruire affidabile, affidabile, conforme. I clienti che utilizzano Sonar sono il 44% meno probabilità di segnalare un outage a causa del codice generato dall'IA. Crediamo che la verifica del codice sia il collegamento mancante fondamentale nel Ciclo di Sviluppo Agent-Centric (AC/DC). I giganti del settore come Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca e Ford Motor Company contano su di noi per fornire una revisione indipendente, spiegabile, coerente e la governance del loro codice generato dall'IA attraverso prodotti come:
• SonarQube: la piattaforma leader mondiale per la revisione e la verifica del codice AI.
• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Attualmente il lancio delle classifiche per la riparazione di software agentic.
• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Fornire il contesto di livello enterprise e gli agenti vincoli devono essere veramente efficaci. Il nostro team opera in tutto il mondo a Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Ginevra, Londra, Singapore, Tokyo e Washington D.C. Ci muoviamo con una mentalità che chiamiamo CODE:
• Impegnati ai nostri clienti e comunità.
• Obsessed con qualità.
• Deliberate nelle nostre decisioni.
• Efficace come una squadra. Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari di ricavi e crescita redditizia e rapida, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione software AI. Se hai fame di avere un impatto, vuoi costruire ad un ritmo veloce, e pronto a lavorare in prima linea di AI, vogliamo sentire da te. Descrizione della posizione A Sonar, stiamo cercando un innovativo Research Engineer per unire il nostro team Data & Agentic e pioniere la prossima generazione del nostro motore di analisi del codice. Sarete in prima linea nell'applicazione di AI all'avanguardia, Large Language Model (LLM) e tecniche agentic al dominio complesso del codice sorgente. Il vostro lavoro formerà direttamente i nostri prodotti, spingendo i confini dell'analisi statica per aiutare milioni di sviluppatori a scrivere codice migliore e più sicuro. Se siete spinti a risolvere i problemi del mondo reale, trasformando la ricerca all'avanguardia in soluzioni pratiche e ad alto impatto, questo è il ruolo per voi. Cosa farai
• Create & Innovate: partecipa attivamente alla fase di concettualizzazione. Brainstorm nuovi modi per migliorare i nostri prodotti e fornire un feedback immediato e pratico per guidare la ricerca esplorativa verso percorsi che sono sia impattanti che ingegneristici.
• Sviluppare modelli AI Avanzati: Progettazione, prototipo e convalidare nuovi modelli ML che identificano e risolvono bug complessi, vulnerabilità e odori di codice, andando oltre le capacità dell'analisi statica tradizionale.
• Sviluppare Prototipi Pragmatici: costruire prototipi hands-on che dimostrano la fattibilità e la scalabilità dei concetti di ricerca. Identificare attivamente i colli di bottiglia di ingegneria o i limiti di scalabilità e proporre efficaci mitigazioni all'inizio della fase di ricerca.
• Valutare & Benchmark: Guidare la rigorosa valutazione di nuove funzioni AI-powered. Costruire set di dati di alta qualità, definire metriche di successo rilevanti e implementare benchmark completi che sfruttano l'IP esistente di Sonar insieme a strumenti AI di terze parti e open source.
• Ingegnere Data Pipelines: Costruire e gestire linee di dati robuste per raccogliere, elaborare e versione enormi set di dati code-centrici necessari per la formazione e la valutazione di modelli specializzati in scala.
• Traduci Prototipi ai Prodotti: Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di ingegneri e prodotti per integrare i prototipi AI di successo nei prodotti all'avanguardia di Sonar, garantendo loro di soddisfare le esigenze della nostra base di utenti globale.
• Comunicare ed Evangelizzare: chiaramente articolare e documentare concetti tecnici complessi e risultati di ricerca a parti interessate sia tecniche che non tecniche. Esperienza e qualifiche
• Forte esperienza nel settore dell'intelligenza artificiale e una solida comprensione delle moderne pratiche e strumenti di ingegneria del software, con esperienza minima di 2 anni nell'industria.
• Eccezionale capacità di programmazione in Python (altri linguaggi di programmazione come Java è un vantaggio forte), e la capacità di scrivere codice pulito e ben documentato per l'integrazione dei prodotti.
• Esperienza pratica che lavora con moderni framework AI/ML, LLM e integrando strumenti AI di terze parti o open source in prototipi funzionali.
• Esperienza comprovata nella gestione dei dati: la costruzione di dataset di alta qualità, la definizione di metriche di successo oggettive e la costruzione di benchmark robusti per le soluzioni AI.
• Esperienza con architetture e tecniche LLM moderne, come:
• Strategie di perfezionamento (ad esempio, LoRA, QLoRA) e ingegneria rapida avanzata.
• Costruire e ottimizzare le tubazioni Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
• Lavorare con database vettoriali e ricerca semantica.
• Esperienza con framework di elaborazione dati su larga scala e infrastrutture cloud (ad esempio AWS).
• Esperienza di guida di progetti di ricerca dall'ideazione iniziale a un prototipo dimostrabile con un alto grado di autonomia.
• La capacità di velocizzare l'interscambio del contesto e di mantenere slancio attraverso più argomenti di ricerca concorrenti e in rapida evoluzione.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese, con un talento per tradurre i risultati di ricerca complessi in artefatti chiari e attuabili per le squadre di ingegneria dei prodotti. Ulteriori commenti Questo ruolo è basato a Ginevra. Non siamo in grado di considerare i candidati che non vogliono essere a Ginevra, ma siamo disposti a trasferire il candidato giusto. Cultura in ufficio Siamo intenzionali. Crediamo che le migliori squadre siano costruite nella stanza insieme. Tre giorni di ancora — lunedì, martedì e giovedì — creano il ritmo di collaborazione che rende un hub office degno di avere. I candidati devono essere autenticamente basati nel luogo in cui il ruolo è pubblicato — se non è lì che sei oggi, siamo lieti di sostenere la delocalizzazione per la persona giusta. Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture. Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono valorizzati e potenziati per contribuire al meglio. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e di accogliere tutti i candidati qualificati, indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere o espressione, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, genetica, disabilità, età, o stato veterano. Se avete bisogno di un alloggio, contattateci all'indirizzo hiring@sonarsource.com . Tutte le offerte di lavoro a Sonar sono contingenti sui risultati di un controllo completo di sfondo e verifica di riferimento effettuato prima della data di inizio. Le domande che vengono presentate tramite agenzie o reclutatori di terze parti non saranno considerate.
